name: vision_analyze
description: Analyze images or a video. Pass images (array) to analyze several in one call — much faster than one call per image. Accepts local paths or http(s) URLs. Video (mp4/mpeg/mov/webm) needs a video-capable model; local videos are capped at 24 MB.

image.description: A single local image/video path or an http(s) URL.

images.description: Several images to analyze in one call (paths or URLs). Overrides image.

prompt.description: Question or instruction for the image analysis. Defaults to a concise description of the image.
